notes: kind is recorded as `linac`; CEBAF is technically a recirculating (racetrack) superconducting linac, which ACCELERATOR_KINDS does not have a dedicated value for.

beam_energy.quote: The CEBAF energy was recently upgraded from 6 GeV to 12 GeV, and an additional experimental area was added to support the highest-energy experiments.

summary.plain: Jefferson Lab's main particle accelerator, which fires a continuous beam of electrons at nuclear targets in three (now four) experimental halls. It began at 4 GeV, was raised to 6 GeV in 2000, and was upgraded again to 12 GeV in 2018.
summary.technical: Continuous Electron Beam Accelerator Facility: a superconducting recirculating (racetrack) electron linac at Jefferson Lab; first beam 1994-07-01, reached its 4 GeV design energy in 1995, an 'enhanced design energy' of 6 GeV in 2000, and 12 GeV after the Upgrade dedicated 2018-05-02.
